subject: general
question: The materials, through which things cannot be seen, are called _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __Opaque materials.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] Key Points__

__
 
• We cannot able to see through some materials, such materials are called Opaque.
 
• Substances that do not pass light through them are called Opaque substances.
 
• Objects on the other side of the opaque objects cannot be seen at all. 
 
• Examples are stone, cardboard, wood, metal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

__Transparent__

__
 
• Substances that allow light to pass through them completely are called Transparent substances.
 
• Objects on the other side of the transparent objects can be seen clearly.
 
• Examples are glass, water, air. 

Translucent__

 
• Substances that allow light to pass through them partially are called Translucent substances.
 
• Objects on the other side of the translucent objects can be seen, but not very clearly.
 
• Examples are oil paper, tissue paper.
